note: L2 — framework-neutral component catalogue for the Flare IM UI Kit. Each component is one contract (props/states/events + core-view data source), realised natively per platform. Grounded in the current flare-core-vue-im-ui reference implementation (props/events extracted from source).

contentTypes.note: MessageBubble/MessageContentView dispatch body rendering to a per-content-type view via a registry. Products register new types here.
